messages:
Jia: quick check — bringing up a new embed variant (arch B, 768d) on the recall suite. seeing weird anchor shifts on short queries.
Omar: thanks. what dataset / split? quick numbers?
Jia: running against semantic-holdout-v2 (10k queries). baseline (arch A, fp16) recall@10 = 0.842. new model fp16 = 0.838. small drop, ok. but int8 quantized new model = 0.793 (!)
Sasha: yikes. that sounds like a quantization-specific degradation, maybe activation clipping or bias shift.
Lucy: did you run per-language breakdown? short queries vs long queries?
Jia: yes — short queries (<=6 tokens) show the biggest gap: fp16 0.81 -> int8 0.72. long queries almost unchanged. suggests token-length-dependent quantization error.
Omar: can you paste the eval command + flags?
Jia: sure:
```
python eval_recall.py --model archB --dim 768 --quant int8 --dataset semantic-holdout-v2 --k 10 --batch 512 --seed 42
```
Sasha: what quant backend? post-training static or QAT?
Jia: post-training symmetric per-channel, using onnxruntime + custom clamp schedule.
Lucy: hmm. try per-tensor vs per-channel, and also `--clip 2.5` vs `--clip 3.5`.
Jia: queued quick runs. also saw UMAP drift — centroids for anchor clusters moved a lot after int8.
eval-bot: automated-report: recall@10 delta (int8 vs fp16) = -4.9% overall, -11.2% short-queries, silhouette score delta = -0.06
Omar: can you dump nearest neighbors for a couple of failing short queries? sample and compare NN ids.
Jia: pasted two examples:
```
query: "how to reset pwd"
fp16 nn: [23, 47, 5, 19, 2]
int8 nn: [102, 88, 9, 5, 19]
```
Sasha: anchor mismatch: top1 changed from a true-match to a different intent. suggests embedding geometry rotated for short-context region.
Lucy: also try L2-normalize before quantization and after dequantize. I remember normalization can help stability.
Jia: trying normalization + per-channel + clip 3.0 now. running 3 seeds.
Omar: if that doesn't fix, we should test chunked KV (different runtime path) — sometimes runtime-specific kernel rounding affects small-seq activations.
Jia: noted. will run and report back. if still bad will escalate to quant infra to check asymmetric int8 pathways.
Sasha: thanks — if you get a run where int8 matches fp16 on short queries, save the model + quant config and we'll do a quick ablation.
Jia: will do. ETA ~45m for current sweep. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Lucy: ping me when done and I'll run the clustering viz notebook.
eval-bot: queued job id 88512, expected finish in ~40m
